R1.text: Bookings, pickup and return are handled from 9am to 6pm, seven days a week.

R2.text: A pickup or return outside 9am to 6pm is passed to staff to arrange.

R3.text: A booking request made outside 9am to 6pm is recorded as pending; staff review it from 9am.

R4.text: A booking needs the customer's name, a mobile number (Malaysian or international) and a driving licence number. The licence itself is checked by staff at pickup (R43).

R5.text: Every booking needs a deposit of RM 100, paid when booking.

R6.text: A booking request blocks the car until staff confirm or reject it. A car blocked or rented for any part of the requested period cannot be booked.

R7.text: The customer reports the deposit payment by uploading the receipt or by saying it was paid. Staff check the bank record; the booking stays pending until staff confirm it.

R8.text: One mobile number may hold up to 2 car bookings at the same time. More cars are passed to staff.

R9.text: The deposit is released within 48 hours after the car is returned with no damage and a full tank (R18).

R10.text: Pickup and return at KLIA are free.

R11.text: Pickup or return at any other place costs RM 1 per km from KLIA. The staff member who delivers or collects the car works out the distance.

R12.text: The minimum rental is 2 hours. Up to 5 hours is charged by the hour; 6 hours or more counts as one day at the daily rate.

R13.text: Beyond whole days, extra hours are charged at the hourly rate, capped at one more day.

R14.text: Whole weeks are charged at the weekly rate and remaining days at the daily rate, capped at the two-week rate.

R15.text: A rented car can be driven at any hour, every day of the week, for the whole rental period.

R16.text: A rental that starts more than 30 days from today, or on the day of the request, is passed to staff. The agent does not block the car.

R17.text: A rental longer than 2 weeks is passed to staff, who may offer a long-term rate. The agent does not quote or promise a discount.

R18.text: Every car is released with a full tank and must be returned with a full tank. Otherwise the cost of refuelling is deducted from the deposit.

R19.text: A cancellation 24 hours or more before pickup: the RM 100 deposit is refunded in full.

R20.text: A cancellation less than 24 hours before pickup: the deposit is kept.

R21.text: No-show: the car is not picked up within 2 hours of the pickup time without notice. The booking is cancelled and the deposit kept.

R22.text: A cancellation is a request until staff confirm it. The agent records it; staff process the refund.

R23.text: Refunds go back to the original payment method within 24 hours of staff confirming the cancellation.

R24.text: If the company cancels (car unavailable), the customer chooses a full deposit refund or a car of the same or higher tier at the same price.

R25.text: Returning early: no refund for unused hours or days.

R26.text: A booking request that staff reject because no payment was found is cancelled; nothing is charged or refunded.

R27.text: A cancellation for an emergency (flight cancelled, medical) less than 24 hours before pickup is decided by staff, with proof.

R28.text: Changing the dates, time or car of a booking is handled by staff.

R29.text: A grace period of 30 minutes after the return time, with no charge.

R30.text: Beyond the grace period, each hour or part hour is charged at the tier's hourly rate.

R31.text: Late charges for one day are capped at the daily rate; 6 hours or more late is charged as one extra day.

R32.text: To extend, the customer asks at least 2 hours before the return time; staff confirm, subject to availability.

R33.text: Late charges are deducted from the deposit; any balance is paid at return.

R34.text: A late return that ends after 6pm needs staff to arrange the return.

R35.text: A car not returned and not contactable 24 hours after the return time is treated as unauthorised use and may be reported to the police.

R36.text: The car is returned to KLIA. Collection from elsewhere is arranged by staff at RM 1 per km, worked out by the staff member who collects it.

R37.text: If a late return stops the next customer's booking, the company offers the next customer another car; the late customer pays the late charges only.

R38.text: The customer tells the company as soon as they know they will be late.

R39.text: The driver is 20 to 70 years old.

R40.text: The driver has held a full licence for at least 2 years. Probationary (P) licences are not accepted.

R41.text: A Malaysian class D licence is accepted.

R42.text: A foreign driver needs a valid national licence plus an International Driving Permit, unless the licence is in English.

R43.text: At pickup, the driver shows the licence and IC or passport; the name must match the booking.

R44.text: Only the person who booked may drive. Damage while anyone else drives is charged to the renter in full.

R45.text: No smoking in the car. A cleaning fee is deducted from the deposit if the car smells of smoke.

R46.text: No pets, unless agreed with staff in advance.

R47.text: The car may not be driven out of Peninsular Malaysia (no Singapore or Thailand) without staff approval.

R48.text: Traffic summonses and tolls during the rental are paid by the renter.
